_about: Targets for grading 'vs tour norms'. tol acts like 1 SD: a value one tol away scores ~61/100, two tols ~14/100. Literature values were measured with 3D motion capture; 2D camera values are approximations, so tolerances are deliberately wider than published SDs. 'heuristic' targets are coaching norms without a single published value and are best judged against your chosen pro.

tempo_ratio.label: Tempo (backswing : downswing)
tempo_ratio.source: GolfDB: median 3.39 (IQR 3.0-4.1) across 1,400 labelled pro swings; Tour Tempo cites ~3:1
tempo_ratio.cue_high: Your backswing is slow relative to your downswing, or you pause at the top. Keep the swing flowing: count '1-2-3' back and '1' down.
tempo_ratio.cue_low: Your transition is rushed. Let the backswing finish before starting down: think 'complete the turn, then go'.

downswing_s.label: Downswing time
downswing_s.source: GolfDB pros (real-time clips, 30 fps labels): median 0.27 s; Chu et al. 2010: 0.30 +/- 0.06 s across 308 golfers
downswing_s.cue_high: Your downswing is slow. Speed drills (swing a lighter club fast, then your normal club) help build speed.
downswing_s.cue_low: Your downswing is very quick for your backswing. Check that the tempo ratio isn't rushed.

backswing_s.label: Backswing time
backswing_s.cue_high: Long, slow backswing. A slightly brisker takeaway often improves rhythm.
backswing_s.cue_low: Very quick backswing. Smooth out the takeaway.

head_rise_impact.label: Head rise at impact
head_rise_impact.cue_high: Your head rises before impact (standing up). Keep your chest down and your eyes on the back of the ball through impact.
head_rise_impact.cue_low: Your head drops toward the ball in the downswing. Maintain the height you set at address.

address_forward_bend.label: Forward bend at address
address_forward_bend.source: Elite golfers' trunk flexion 41.5 +/- 2.9 deg (JSSM 2018, 11 KPGA pros)
address_forward_bend.cue_high: You're bent over too much at address. Stand a little taller and let your arms hang naturally.
address_forward_bend.cue_low: You're too upright at address. Hinge more from the hips (push your backside back) while keeping your back straight.

lead_knee_flex_address.label: Lead knee flex at address
lead_knee_flex_address.cue_high: Too much knee bend. Soften the knees just enough to feel athletic.
lead_knee_flex_address.cue_low: Legs are too straight. Add a little knee flex for balance.

trail_knee_flex_address.label: Trail knee flex at address
trail_knee_flex_address.cue_high: Too much trail knee bend at setup.
trail_knee_flex_address.cue_low: Trail leg is too straight at setup. Flex it slightly.

posture_change_top.label: Posture change at top
posture_change_top.source: Chu 2010: forward tilt nearly constant top vs impact
posture_change_top.cue_high: You bend further over in the backswing. Turn around your spine angle rather than dipping.
posture_change_top.cue_low: You lift out of your posture in the backswing. Keep your spine angle as you turn.

posture_change_impact.label: Posture change at impact
posture_change_impact.source: Chu 2010: forward tilt 22.0 deg (top) vs 22.6 deg (impact)
posture_change_impact.cue_high: You dive toward the ball in the downswing. Keep your chest over the ball and rotate.
posture_change_impact.cue_low: You stand up through impact (loss of posture). Keep your spine angle until after the ball is gone.

early_extension.label: Early extension (hips toward ball)
early_extension.source: TPI: 67% of 90,000+ golfers early-extend; 99% of tested tour players do not
early_extension.cue_high: Early extension: your hips move toward the ball in the downswing. Wall drill: set up with your backside touching a wall and keep it there to impact.
early_extension.cue_low: Your hips move away from the ball through impact. Stay centred over your feet.

head_toward_ball_impact.label: Head move toward ball
head_toward_ball_impact.cue_high: Your head moves toward the ball. Feel your weight stay balanced in the middle of your feet.
head_toward_ball_impact.cue_low: Your head moves away from the ball (pulling up and back).

hands_above_plane_top.label: Hands vs shoulder-plane line at top
hands_above_plane_top.source: No club data: proxy for swing plane. Judged against your chosen pro only.
hands_above_plane_top.cue_high: Your hands finish higher (steeper) at the top than your pro's.
hands_above_plane_top.cue_low: Your hands finish lower (flatter) at the top than your pro's.

head_sway_top.label: Head sway at top (toward trail)
head_sway_top.source: heuristic: rotate around a mostly centred head
head_sway_top.cue_high: Your head sways away from the target in the backswing. Turn your shoulders around a steady head.
head_sway_top.cue_low: Your head moves toward the target in the backswing (reverse pivot). Let your weight load into your trail side.

head_shift_impact.label: Head shift at impact (toward target)
head_shift_impact.source: heuristic: head stays behind the ball
head_shift_impact.cue_high: Your head drifts toward the target before impact. Keep it behind the ball.
head_shift_impact.cue_low: Your head hangs far back at impact. Shift more pressure to your lead side.

pelvis_sway_top.label: Pelvis sway at top (toward trail)
pelvis_sway_top.source: Chu 2010: pelvis ~2 +/- 2 cm toward trail at top
pelvis_sway_top.cue_high: Your hips slide away from the target in the backswing. Turn instead of sliding: feel the trail hip go back, not sideways.
pelvis_sway_top.cue_low: Your hips drift toward the target in the backswing (reverse pivot).

pelvis_slide_impact.label: Pelvis slide at impact (toward target)
pelvis_slide_impact.source: Chu 2010: pelvis ~2 +/- 3 cm toward target at impact
pelvis_slide_impact.cue_high: Your hips slide too far toward the target. Post up on your lead leg and rotate.
pelvis_slide_impact.cue_low: Your hips hang back at impact. Shift pressure to your lead foot early in the downswing.

shoulder_tilt_top.label: Shoulder tilt at top (lead down)
shoulder_tilt_top.source: Meister et al. 2011 (10 pros, 5-iron): peak 48 +/- 4 deg
shoulder_tilt_top.cue_high: Your lead shoulder dips too much going back (a tilt rather than a turn).
shoulder_tilt_top.cue_low: Your shoulders turn too flat. Let the lead shoulder work down and across.

shoulder_tilt_impact.label: Shoulder tilt at impact (trail down)
shoulder_tilt_impact.source: Meister et al. 2011: 25 +/- 3 deg at impact
shoulder_tilt_impact.cue_high: Your trail shoulder drops a lot at impact. Watch for hanging back.
shoulder_tilt_impact.cue_low: Shoulders are level at impact. Let the trail shoulder work down as you rotate.

side_bend_impact.label: Side bend at impact (toward trail)
side_bend_impact.source: Chu 2010: 14.4 +/- 6.5 deg toward trail at impact
side_bend_impact.cue_high: Excessive side bend away from the target at impact: often a sign of hanging back.
side_bend_impact.cue_low: Your upper body is too far ahead of the ball at impact. Keep your spine tilted slightly away from the target.

lead_arm_straightness_top.label: Lead arm angle at top
lead_arm_straightness_top.source: heuristic: near-straight lead arm; occlusion makes this noisy
lead_arm_straightness_top.cue_low: Your lead arm bends at the top. Keep width: a slightly shorter, wider backswing helps.

shoulder_turn_top.label: Shoulder turn at top (approx.)
shoulder_turn_top.source: Myers 2008: ~104 deg in 3D; 2D projection cannot exceed 90 deg, so treat as a trend
shoulder_turn_top.cue_low: Limited shoulder turn. Let your lead shoulder turn under your chin; allow your lead heel to lift slightly if you need to.

hip_turn_top.label: Hip turn at top (approx.)
hip_turn_top.cue_high: Your hips over-rotate in the backswing, which reduces stretch. Brace the trail knee.
hip_turn_top.cue_low: Restricted hip turn. Let the trail hip rotate back.

x_factor_top.label: X-factor at top (approx.)
x_factor_top.source: TPI tour average ~45 deg; Myers 2008: 59 +/- 8 deg (fast group, 3D)
x_factor_top.cue_low: Little separation between shoulders and hips at the top. Turn your shoulders more than your hips.
